title: FormoreCo – Company Website (Static)
intro: A fast, static marketing website that showcases services, projects, and contact routes with minimal maintenance.
summary: Next.js static export with modular sections, responsive Tailwind UI, structured data, and Vercel deployments.
features: Componentized pages (Home, Services, Projects, About, Contact)

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A static company website that highlights FormoreCo’s services and portfolio, optimized for performance and SEO with minimal operational overhead.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Deliver a professional online presence that is discoverable, fast, and easy to maintain without a dynamic backend.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Built responsive, branded UI in Tailwind; modularized sections; configured SEO and Vercel deployments; implemented a validated contact flow.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Component-based pages; pre-rendered routes; structured data; image optimization; data-driven sections for quick edits.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Balanced simplicity with extensibility—kept static build while preparing the codebase for future sections without adding backend complexity.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Improved brand credibility and reach with a fast, reliable site and negligible maintenance cost.
